system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Advantage on Persuasion when enforcing a contract or vow. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a stated oath (Will save negates). Your first hit each encounter with your war hammer binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
